items.text: Packers ruled out WR Christian Watson after evaluation for concussion (also thigh earlier). Caught 4/4 for 65 yards before exiting vs Rams.
items.why: Concussion from sideline hit; second documented concussion.
items.implication: Misses remainder of TNF; 11 days to clear for Week 13.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/targets for other Packers WRs

items.text: Chiefs officially ruled out RB Kenneth Walker for Thursday night vs Bills due to groin injury. Rookie Emmett Johnson will start for the third straight game.
items.why: Groin injury; DNP Wednesday after limited earlier in week.
items.implication: Full lead role for backup RB; Walker misses third straight.
items.opportunity: Backup RB every-down usage including carries/targets/RZ

items.text: Rams ruled out TE Tyler Higbee due to chest injury. Already ruled out TE Davis Allen. Both exited TNF vs Packers.
items.implication: Rams thin at TE with Ferguson already season-ending; Parkinson next up.
items.opportunity: TE snaps/routes/targets to remaining Rams TEs

items.text: 49ers QB Brock Purdy did not practice Wednesday with ankle injury from SNF. Day-to-day per reports.
items.implication: Monitor practice; not expected to miss but worth watching for Week 12.

items.text: LOVE Bucky Irving this week. Since Week 5 only Gibbs and CMC averaged more FPPG among RBs; now gets Carolina.
items.why: Elite recent FPPG + soft CAR matchup.
items.opportunity: High snap/touch share vs weak run D

items.text: Jaguars RB Bhayshul Tuten did not practice Wednesday due to foot/ankle injuries. Could be GTD.
items.implication: Monitor; next man up if sits.
items.opportunity: Backup RB carries/snaps if Tuten out

items.text: Derrick Henry target share jumped to 12% and 4.5 rec/g with Brissett (from <6%/1.3). Raises PPR floor.
items.why: Two games with Brissett show elevated receiving role.
items.implication: Higher PPR floor; LOVE for volume.

items.text: Puka Nacua and Terrance Ferguson out for the season (Nacua MCL surgery 4-5 months). Highlighted in Week 12 preview.
items.why: MCL surgery recovery 4-5 months; rules out playoffs.
items.implication: Rams WR/TE corps depleted long-term; Adams return candidate later.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets for remaining Rams pass-catchers

items.text: HATE Bo Nix this week. Expecting lots of Jonah Coleman vs PIT; not enough rushing from Nix. Outside top 20.
items.why: Run-heavy script expected; limited rush production.

items.text: On Travis Etienne: could see disappointing snaps/routes down stretch but reasonably high carry count. Gets ARZ/ATL Weeks 16/17. Cites Graziano.
items.why: Snaps/routes may lag but carries solid; favorable late schedule.
items.implication: Carry-floor playoff RB with volume risk on routes/targets.
items.opportunity: Carry share floor; schedule boost Weeks 16-17

items.text: DeVonta Smith 57% target share Week 11; 36% avg in 5 games, 50% EZ targets. Role elite despite injuries tanking season.
items.why: Massive target share and red-zone work.

items.text: Ladd McConkey season-high 38% target share on return; 17.5 PPG when 20%+ share. Solid if stays healthy.
items.why: High share and efficiency on limited healthy snaps.

items.text: Jaylen Warren only 51% rush attempts since Dowdle return, low targets; D'Andre Swift 47% snaps/39% rushes with Monangai back. Both mid-low RB2.
Trey McBride 39% target share last 2 but 3 aDOT/low YPR (volume TE but not elite). Emeka Egbuka last in YPT among 50+ tgt WRs, under 12 PPR in 17/20 recent.
items.why: McBride short aDOT limits upside; Egbuka efficiency collapse.
items.implication: McBride solid but not WR-level; fade Egbuka.
